analysis.title: DeskTalk - US retail sales add to hawkish case
key_insights: October US retail sales control group rose 0.6% MoM vs 0.3% expected, pushing front-end yields higher and extending a run of stronger-than-expected US data this month.
September retail sales were revised higher across nearly every category. The control group was revised to 0.5% from 0.1%.
A decline in higher-ticket items such as cars and furniture masked broad gains in health and personal care, gas stations and building materials.
Markets read the report as validation of increasingly hawkish Fed messaging that began before CPI, when Governor Waller argued for an additional 50bps of hikes.
Non-voter Musalem said the Fed may need "several" more hikes before spring and that the real policy rate should be roughly 1 percentage point higher.
Front-end UST yields rose about 7bps to 4.851% and DXY rose 0.16% to 103.72. US equity futures (ESA) were down 0.25% as attention turned to Nvidia earnings after the close.
earnings_insights: Nvidia earnings are due after the close on the day of the note. No estimates are given.
